title: A hash-valid artifact whose `IHDR` CRC does not verify
why: Its `IDAT` sibling leaves 'verify the CRC of the compressed data only' passing the whole suite, and that is a natural thing to implement — the data chunk is the one whose corruption obviously matters. But `v1` permits exactly five chunks, every one of them consumed, so every CRC is fatal; a corrupt `IHDR`, `PLTE`, `tRNS` or `IEND` otherwise reaches a gate verdict here and `decode-failed` from a native decoder. The header bytes themselves are left valid, so only the checksum can refuse this file.
